title: Identity and naming definitions
description: Shared identity definitions (F2-02, schema-strategy). NON-NORMATIVE machine artifact: the normative source is spec/core/identity.md and spec/core/versioning.md. Anchors: identity.md §2, §2.1-§2.2, §8; versioning.md §2, §4; manifest/README.md §3.

slugName.description: Harness slug within an owner namespace: 1-64 characters, lowercase ASCII, digits and interior hyphens only, and it MUST NOT contain '/'. F1: core/identity.md §2; manifest/README.md §3.2.

owner.description: Owner namespace authority: 1-40 characters, lowercase ASCII, digits and interior hyphens only. An owner is a namespace, not a user account. F1: core/identity.md §2, §5.

scopedReference.description: Scoped reference '@owner/slug'. It resolves against the same host as the manifest that contains it. F1: core/identity.md §2.1, §5.3.

canonicalIdentifier.description: Canonical identifier 'https://<host>/h/<owner>/<slug>[@<version>]'. The scheme MUST be https. The host is a VARIABLE and the definitive canonical host and namespace are OPEN (decision record §58, open question 'canonical host / namespace'); this schema MUST NOT fix a host. F1: core/identity.md §2.2, §8.

semver.description: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with optional pre-release and build metadata. F1: core/versioning.md §2.

versionRange.description: Compatibility or version range. The precise surface syntax of version ranges is OPEN (decision record §58, open question 'dependencies and composition'); this schema MUST NOT fix a range grammar. The resolution semantics that ARE fixed are the inclusive lower bound, the upper bound and the ordering over stability stages. F1: core/versioning.md §4; core/dependencies.md §8.
